Pose - Seated Relaxed.description:
🕴️ Pose: Seated Relaxed
Sitting in a comfortable position — leaning back or resting, suggesting a casual, off-duty moment.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Pose - Seated Relaxed.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Within the selected Portrait Framing, use relaxed seated body geometry only when a seat or ledge is supported by the selected scene; otherwise use a relaxed standing weight shift. Preserve the selected crop and show only frame-visible limbs and hands. Female: knees together or crossed, shoulders soft and low. Male: knees apart, shoulders open and level. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own seated geometry.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
